tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List ProseCraft projects in the open sync folder.

tools.name: list_chapters
tools.description: List chapters in a project, optionally filtered by label or Trash state.

trashed.description: true lists only trashed chapters; omit for live ones

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List scenes (documents) and Wiki pages in a project, optionally filtered by chapter, label or Trash state.

trashed.description: true lists only trashed scenes; omit for live ones

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search scene and Wiki page titles and bodies with the app's matching rules: literal query, diacritics folded unless caseSensitive, optional wholeWord. Returns one result per document with a short plain-text snippet around the first match.

space.description: Only scenes or only Wiki pages

folderId.description: Only Wiki pages in this folder

tools.name: read_scene
tools.description: Read one scene as Markdown with metadata; fields carries every frontmatter field as stored. Trashed scenes fail unless includeTrashed is set.

includeTrashed.description: Read the scene even if it is in the Trash

tools.name: list_wiki_pages
tools.description: List Wiki pages with title, folder path and kind; no bodies.

folderId.description: Only pages directly in this Wiki folder

tools.name: read_wiki_page
tools.description: Read one Wiki page: Markdown body plus every frontmatter field as fields.

tools.name: list_wiki_folders
tools.description: List the Wiki folder tree.

tools.name: write_scene
tools.description: Create or update a scene. Omit sceneId to create with a generated id. Only title, chapterId and the body change; every other frontmatter field is preserved. An unknown sceneId fails unless create is true. Overwriting an existing scene first stores its previous text as a snapshot unless snapshot is false; the result carries the snapshot id (null when none was taken). Pass expectedRevision to fail instead of overwriting a newer edit; the result carries the new revision.

create.description: Create a new scene when sceneId is unknown

snapshot.description: Set false to skip the snapshot before overwriting

expectedRevision.description: Fail unless the stored scene revision equals this

tools.name: trash_scene
tools.description: Move a scene to Trash (tombstone + remove file). Pass expectedRevision to fail instead of trashing a newer edit; the result carries the new revision.

expectedRevision.description: Fail unless the stored scene revision equals this

tools.name: create_chapter
tools.description: Create a chapter.

tools.name: update_chapter
tools.description: Rename a chapter or update its summary. Pass expectedRevision to fail instead of overwriting a newer edit; the result carries the new revision.

expectedRevision.description: Fail unless the stored chapter revision equals this

tools.name: create_wiki_page
tools.description: Create a Wiki page (space: "Wiki"). folderId must be an existing Wiki folder, labelId an existing label. The result carries the new revision.

tools.name: update_wiki_page
tools.description: Update a Wiki page. Omitted fields keep their stored value and every other frontmatter field is preserved. The previous text is stored as a snapshot first; the result carries the snapshot id and new revision. Pass expectedRevision to fail instead of overwriting a newer edit.

folderId.description: Move the page to this Wiki folder

expectedRevision.description: Fail unless the stored page revision equals this

tools.name: set_label
tools.description: Set or clear the label of a document or a chapter. labelId null clears it; an unknown labelId fails without writing.

chapterId.description: Chapter id; pass either this or documentId

labelId.description: Label from list_labels, or null to clear

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment anchored to a quote in a document. The quote must occur exactly once in the plain text; prefix and suffix context are stored like the app does.

quote.description: Exact passage the comment is anchored to

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark a comment as resolved.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List project labels with the number of live documents and chapters using each.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments, optionally for one document. Resolved comments appear only with includeResolved.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List snapshot metadata, newest first; no text. Optionally only for one document.

tools.name: read_snapshot
tools.description: Read one snapshot, including its stored text.
